description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Upgrade11' extending a system controller, responsible for performing database schema updates and data migrations during an upgrade process to version 11 in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It contains methods to update customer data, address fields, customer groups, affiliates, API entries, carts, and performs table/field cleanup as part of the upgrade routine.

classes.name: Upgrade11
classes.description: A controller class for performing database schema updates and data migration during system upgrade to version 11.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method executing the upgrade steps, including database updates, data migrations, field and table removals, and preparing JSON response for the upgrade process.
